result.title: Exact on Paper: Which LLM Serving Shortcuts Flip Graded Answers, Measured Against the Noise of Reordering the Same Requests
result.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Also archived on Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.24433980
result.summary: Teams enable serving features such as prefix caching, chunked prefill and speculative decoding after checking that benchmark accuracy is unchanged, because the engine documents them as exact. Accuracy is an aggregate, so a feature can hold it while flipping which requests are answered correctly. We serve one 4B instruction model in vLLM under nine single feature configurations and five replicas of a reference configuration, grade 3,380 requests from five benchmarks in every run, and compare each candidate with a restart floor (fresh process) and a scheduling floor (same requests in a different order). With default kernels every configuration keeps accuracy within one point, and the seven exact features flip the graded outcome of 1.47% (95% CI 1.13 to 1.85) to 1.78% (1.39 to 2.20) of requests, none above the scheduling floor of 1.72%, while the FP8 KV cache flips 3.36% (2.80 to 3.96), as many as FP8 weights. With batch invariant kernels all seven exact features, speculative decoding included, reproduce the reference text on every request, while the FP8 KV cache still flips 3.91% (3.28 to 4.53) of graded outcomes. A gate that compares against a single replica pair rejected an unchanged configuration, so we recommend certifying a serving change under batch invariant kernels, where the floor is zero, or against a scheduling floor measured from at least three replicas.

AI.brief_summary: 在 vLLM 上以九种单特性配置和五个参考配置副本服务同一 4B 模型，对五个基准的 3380 条请求逐条判分，比较各特性相对「重启底线」和「调度底线」造成的判分翻转率，发现七个被文档称为 exact 的特性翻转约 1.5%–1.8%、不高于调度噪声，而 FP8 KV cache 翻转约 3.4%–3.9%，batch invariant kernel 可消除 exact 特性的翻转。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心论点是聚合准确率会掩盖逐请求翻转，这与 LVR 中判断 THINK/LOOK/STOP 或 latent 状态改动是否真正带来收益的问题同构；调度地板、多副本基线与 batch invariant 核可供核查推理期增益和 KV 缓存压缩对答案的因果影响是否超出服务噪声。
